verdict.rationale: Dialpad's own documentation describes a first-party Python client library and API-key/OAuth authenticated APIs. These let scripts drive the platform programmatically without the UI, which amounts to headless automation. Nothing in the evidence shows a CLI, CI integration guidance, or a documented headless/service-account workflow, so support is limited to API-driven scripting. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI/CD integration docs or examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of unattended automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Dialpad also provides a python client library, making it easier than ever to use the APIs in your python applications.
